title: Towards a Fatality-Aware Benchmark of Probabilistic Reaction Prediction in Highly Interactive Driving Scenarios
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on benchmarking probabilistic reaction prediction models for autonomous vehicles.
